meta.description: Simulation study for 'The Dark Figure' (synthetic data only; no real incidents). Run 2.
meta.run: run 2 (after the 2026-11-03 code audit); run 1 is kept in results/sim_results_run1.json
meta.seed_scheme: world seed = SeedSequence([base_seed, SEED_ID[scenario], level_index+1, rep]); pipeline seed = SeedSequence([..., rep, 7]); level_index = -1 for single-level scenarios. SEED_ID is fixed per scenario id (independent of --only); its values equal the run-1 positions, so S1-S5 and S7 use the same worlds as run 1. S8 uses the world seed.

date.definition: |date difference| in days: 0 | 1-2 | 3-7 | >=8 (up to the blocking window)

hour.definition: circular |hour difference|: <=1 | 2-3 | >=4 | missing on either side

location.definition: same county | different (adjacent) county | county unknown on either side

type.definition: harmonised type sets: both single and equal | overlapping | disjoint

venue.definition: Jaro-Winkler similarity of normalised venue strings: >=0.96 | >=0.90 | >=0.80 | <0.80 | missing on either side

fs_em.missing_handling: 'missing' is an explicit comparison level with its own m and u probabilities (no missing-at-random marginalisation)
classes: related non-match (shares venue/location/type, e.g. repeat targets)
fs_em.tie_rule: the two non-match classes share one date and one hour distribution (M-step pools their expected counts); the related class can only explain venue/location/type agreement
fs_em.conditional_independence: fields independent given the class (within each of the 3 classes)
fs_em.init: match class: geometric agreement profile 0.25^level (missing levels at their overall frequency); related class: agreement profile on location/type/venue, overall date/hour; unrelated class: overall frequencies; weights (0.04, 0.04, 0.92)
fs_em.match_class_identification: class with the largest P(exact date agreement)
fs_em.fit_sequence: (1) EM on all cross-list candidate pairs; (2) within-list de-duplication with the class-conditional distributions held fixed and class proportions re-estimated by EM on the within-list pairs, union-find on posterior >= 0.5; (3) EM refit, warm-started at (1), on cross-list pairs among the de-duplicated representatives
fs_em.posterior: pi = P(match class | gamma) with the fitted class proportions
fs_em.blocking: same or adjacent county (or either unknown) and |date difference| <= 14 days
fs_em.point_linkage: greedy merging by descending pi over pairs with pi >= 0.5, at most one record per list per cluster

estimators.lcmcr: lcmcr(table, J=10, n_iter=7500, burn=2500, thin=5, n_chains=4); per fit 4 chains x 7500 iterations = 30000 iterations (the 30000 recommended by SIM-EST, split over 4 chains with overdispersed n0 starts 0.5/1/2/4 x the Chao-type default) -> 4000 pooled draws; rank-normalised split-Rhat and bulk/tail ESS of N for every oracle / naive fit (Vehtari et al. 2021). This is a REDUCED protocol relative to App. app:comp-diag (which requires Rhat < 1.01 and ESS >= 400); the fraction of fits meeting it is reported in estimates[...]['lcmcr']['diag'].

lcmcr_protocol.corrected: link_var='impute': one chain per imputed table t* ~ N(t_hat, J^-1 Sigma J^-T) (4 imputations), draws pooled; no Rhat
lcmcr_protocol.mi: one chain per Gibbs linkage draw for the first 4 draws, pooled; no Rhat

linkage_variance.method: delta method (link_var='delta'): v_link = a' Sigma a, a = J^{-T} grad F(t_hat); J = Jacobian of t -> E[T(delta, eps) t] at t_hat (D_delta times the first-order merge Jacobian); Sigma = Cov(n~|t_hat) under LE (exact detachment covariance sum_h t_h Cov(Z_h) of Cor cor:linkcorrect(i), propagated through the merge Jacobian, plus the first-order merge covariance); grad F by forward differences (step max(0.05, 1e-3 t_h)). v_link is added to the inner interval on its log(N - a) scale (a = n_obs, or n12 for LP): s^2 -> s^2 + log(1 + v_link / (N_hat - a)^2), per side.
linkage_variance.why_not_bootstrap: a parametric bootstrap through simulate_observed was the alternative; the delta method costs ~16 estimator calls instead of ~100-200 per table and, on S8, its covariance of the observed table matches Monte Carlo (tests/test_estimators.py::test_observed_covariance_matches_monte_carlo)
linkage_variance.audit_variance: corrected_tv / corrected_review_tv: + v_aud = sum_j (dN_hat/dtheta_j)^2 se_j^2 (central differences; Cor cor:linkcorrect(iii)); conservative when the audit sampled the same linkage (Rem. rem:link-sameaudit)
linkage_variance.lcmcr: one chain per imputation t* ~ N(t_hat, J^-1 Sigma J^-T) (4 imputations), pooled

mi_sampler.kind: approximate posterior draws: single-record Gibbs sampler over constrained partitions targeting the plug-in FS pairwise posterior prod_{within-cluster pairs} omega_rr' (omega = pi/(1-pi) for candidate pairs with pi >= tau = 0.001, omega_0 = tau/(1-tau) for other within-cluster pairs); <= 1 record per list per cluster; clusters connected via retained edges; start = point linkage; 5 burn-in sweeps then 20 draws every 1 sweep(s). Empirical Bayes (m, u, p fixed at FS-EM values): not a full Bayesian record-linkage posterior.
mi_sampler.run1: independent Bernoulli(pi) link proposals resolved greedily (darkfig.linkage.sample_linkage_bernoulli): NOT posterior draws; replaced in run 2

review.kind: random stratified audit of Prop. prop:link-audit (Neyman allocation over link status x posterior bins, B = 300 candidate pairs); NOT the targeted review of Alg. alg:review; reviewed links are not fixed in the linkage
review.frame: candidate (blocked) cross-list pairs among de-duplicated representatives; the estimand on that frame is linkage.frame (delta_frame, eps_frame), compared with the review in linkage.delta_err_frame / delta_ci_coverage_frame; blocking recall is reported separately; delta_true / eps_true are the capture-level LE rates over all true pairs
review.s8_audit: S8: simple random sample of 200 records (true counterparts revealed; ratio estimator of pairwise recall) + 100 linked spanning-forest edges (false fraction) -> (delta_hat, eps_hat)

pipelines.naive: single best linkage (3-class FS EM, greedy constrained, threshold 0.5)
pipelines.corrected: linkage_corrected with audit (delta_hat, eps_hat); interval = v_cap + v_link
pipelines.corrected_tv: corrected + audit variance v_aud (delta method); conservative
pipelines.corrected_true: linkage_corrected with realised capture-level LE rates (representatives); + v_link
pipelines.corrected_d: post-hoc variant (run 1): audit delta_hat, eps = 0; + v_link
pipelines.corrected_lefit: diagnostic: best-fit scalar LE (delta*, eps*) using the oracle table (infeasible); + v_link
pipelines.mi: 20 Gibbs linkage draws; Rubin's rules on log(N_hat - c), c = min_m n_obs^(m), within variance from each draw's log-normal interval on N - a (lp, cf, bma, chao); LCMCR: one chain per draw for the first 4 draws, pooled
pipelines.oracle_dropref: oracle linkage after dropping referral-only NGO records (provenance flag)
pipelines.corrected_known: S8: linkage_corrected with the true LE (delta, eps); interval v_cap + v_link (coverage_cap = without v_link)
pipelines.corrected_review: S8: linkage_corrected with audit-estimated rates; v_cap + v_link

metrics.relbias_median: PRIMARY: median over replicates of (N_hat - N)/N
metrics.relbias_median_mcse: half-width of the distribution-free 95% order-statistic CI for the median / 1.96
metrics.relbias_mad_sd: 1.4826 x median absolute deviation of (N_hat - N)/N (robust spread)
metrics.n_blowup: number of replicates with N_hat > 5.0 N
metrics.relbias_n0: (N_hat - N)/n0_true = ((N_hat - n_obs_true) - n0_true)/n0_true: dark-figure error with the COMMON oracle observed count and denominator (median primary, mean secondary)
metrics.relbias_n0_own: ((N_hat - n_obs_pipeline) - n0_true)/n0_true: the pipeline's own dark-figure estimate (run-1 'relbias_n0'), reported for reference
metrics.coverage: P(lo <= N <= hi) for the nominal 95% interval
metrics.coverage_cap: corrected pipelines: coverage of the inner interval without v_link (the run-1 interval)

changes_vs_run1: S8 added (table generated exactly by the LE model; known and audit-estimated rates)
corrected intervals include v_link (delta method); run-1 intervals kept as coverage_cap
corrected_tv: delta-method audit variance instead of 20 draws + Rubin on log N
MI: Gibbs sampler over constrained partitions instead of Bernoulli(pi) + greedy
Rubin's rules on log(N_hat - c) with within-variance from se on log(N - a) (was log N)
summaries: median relative bias primary, mean secondary, MAD spread, blow-up count
relbias_n0 uses the common oracle n_obs / n0_true; the per-pipeline version is relbias_n0_own
LCMCR: 4 chains x 7500 (burn 2500, thin 5) with Rhat/ESS; R_lcmcr = 10 (S1, S3), 25 (S2, S4)
audit compared with its estimand on the candidate-pair frame; blocking recall reported
seeds keyed to fixed scenario ids
Jaro similarity reimplemented with str.find (identical values, ~2x faster)

S3.label: referral dependence q = 0.5 (independent capture), clean records

S7.label: referral sweep with provenance correction (oracle linkage)

S8.label: observed table generated exactly by the LE model (independent capture, N = 2000)
